worksheet.title: Product Listing Worksheet
worksheet.description: Build your listing. Title, description, objection handling, and photo plan — all in one place.

fields.label: Product title
fields.helpText: Lead with core search terms, then add specificity. What it is + who it is for + one key detail.

fields.label: Product description draft
fields.helpText: Lead with the problem and your solution. Then cover specifications, what's included, compatibility, care instructions, and shipping. Write it for your specific customer from Chapter 7.

fields.label: Objections addressed
fields.helpText: What would make your customer hesitate? List the top 2–3 objections and confirm your description answers each one.

fields.label: Key photos needed
fields.helpText: List the shots you need: clean product shot, detail shot, scale shot, in-use shot. Add any others specific to your product.

fields.label: Photos taken
fields.helpText: Check this once you have taken your product photos.
